notes.title: TOWERHEX update
notes.content:
Thank you to all who participated in the early access! We have completed a significant update, replacing levels that were not so good with new ones, including new visuals, level design and puzzles. The improvement focus was put mainly on the plot development to fit the gameplay and increase the feeling of immersion for players who directly participate in the game’s story. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34123288/266bd475f49b426dc61a809210220a84574160a0.png[/img]

Since we are a team of only five people, the progress might be slower than we hoped for, but we will do our best to continue improving the game until it reaches next level of quality!


[b]Major changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Replaced training camp level with direct gameplay in a new story revealing level
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34123288/ad7522c23feeeb3cee02cdd09a90ed85c8d6d775.png[/img]

[*] Added Victor’s room/Observatory level with new puzzles
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34123288/99e72bd1781d9522b6f83b040bb8947c916d31d8.png[/img]

[*] Added Castle Treasury level with new puzzles 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34123288/fbc21844a8977e300ebd9ec1ea2c4e5395cc828d.png[/img]

[*] Upcoming level with Secret Passage to castle with new puzzles
[*] Upcoming Tavern level for more story progression
[*] Improved Final level with major visual and sound effects for story and immersion
[*] Improved sound design and voice acting
[*] Full story and voice acting plan prepared for further updates
[*] Minor technical fixes to gameplay
